name: designer_enrich_approve_block_ticket_healthy
why: Same ask on a box where everything is reachable: separates box state from app behavior.
goal: From the empty playbook open in the designer, build a playbook that runs on an alert: enrich the alert's source IP, ask an analyst to approve, then block the IP on the FortiGate, then open a ticket in ServiceNow.
